title: Full gate in a fresh worktree without ui/node_modules fails with a raw runner ENOENT on tsc and all stages unrun, instead of a named dependency preflight failure
outcome: Before any stage, the launcher checks the worktree's UI dependencies (ui/node_modules, including typescript/bin/tsc). When they're missing, it fails with a clear preflight message naming the missing path and the setup step, not a raw ENOENT.
acceptance: Full gate in a fresh worktree without ui/node_modules fails with a raw runner ENOENT on tsc and all stages unrun, instead of a named dependency preflight failure is done
